notes.title: Trial Play of Phantom Beast Cards
notes.content:
Phantom Beast Solitaire is a casual puzzle card game. Each start will have a different beginning. You need to defeat monsters through the cooperation of game cards, beast cards, constellation cards, and magic cards to complete the level.



This greatly tests everyone's ability to choose early strategies, consume resources, and integrate.



The product is not yet perfect, and more content needs to be produced. I hope everyone can communicate more. Design more and more fun expansion gameplay.
